summary: Jared clarified the ledger is for long Chain Wizard/Codex feature-spec conversations and Plan building, not the actual assistant memory system and not Plan Mode.
Accepted architecture: file-backed Bootstrap Ledger now; Native Ledger Service later; same conceptual standard with different implementation depth.
Repo has live canonical Plans docs, governance validators, existing plan graph/project plan node schemas, and legacy source ledgers. Existing Plans are governance-standardized but not layout-uniform.
Plan docs, ledger, and work-node conversion must be designed together via DesignAtom -> PlanUnit -> NodeSeed -> WorkNode.
Jared corrected that retired prompt-packet/tranche experiments must not be referenced or used as architecture; Goal + new ledger replaces that failed approach.
Jared clarified Codex Goal prompts must be under 4,000 characters and phases will likely run in separate Codex threads.
User clarified PlanUnit index/node-readiness must not create WorkNodes yet; WorkNodes wait until Plans and compiler contract are complete.
User clarified GUI classification must be automatic and simple: use gui_related boolean, not user-declared or granular taxonomy.
